concept: The courage to state an unpopular but well-supported truth
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Galileo's own historical experience — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student has well-supported information that contradicts what a group or authority figure wants to hear
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether, how, and to whom to voice it
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how to voice a hard truth in a way that's honest but not needlessly confrontational

assessment.success_marker: student distinguishes between staying silent, being needlessly harsh, and finding a constructive way to speak up
